integrity: The complete proof identifies collision columns and bijectively enumerates all fixed configurations; directly implemented brute force, independent transfer constraints, and exact polynomial coefficient checks agree on overlapping domains. Scientific status is same-model-reviewed only.
scientific_limitations: Two-row periodic HPP gas, four direction-labelled channels per site, labelled configurations and exact one-step fixed states only; neither thicker tori nor all recurrent trajectories are classified. The joint central limit theorem samples fixed microstates uniformly, not equilibrium measures of arbitrary trajectories. Earlier primary full texts could not be inspected completely, so priority remains qualified.
title: Collision-column parity and joint fixed-state statistics of the HPP lattice gas on two-row tori
